scientific_question: Among the gas-concentration fields in the kitchen airflow, which field is most spatially heterogeneous? Treat the point-associated fields c1 and c11–c17 as separate candidates. For each candidate, first compute the arithmetic mean of its finite vertex values in each cell, ignore cells with non-positive volume, and then calculate the coefficient of variation using cell volume as the weight. Select the field with the largest value and report its identifier and coefficient of variation.
